contributions.name: XAI explanation quality
evidence: Top-SHAP deletion exceeds random-mask controls for k=10,25,50 under mean and median baselines.
Within-fold SHAP rank stability: Spearman=0.614440; Jaccard top-10=0.622065.
limits: Labels are generic benign/malware, not ransomware-specific.

contributions.name: XAI-Guided Active Learning
evidence: U+H beats Random by ROC-AULC 0.004249 and AP-AULC 0.014985, winning 5/5 folds.
U+H beats Uncertainty by ROC-AULC 0.001754 and AP-AULC 0.001401, winning 4/5 folds.
XAI_full saves 92 labels versus Random and 28 versus Uncertainty on average, with high fold variation.
limits: Low-FPR performance is clearly better than Random but approximately tied with Uncertainty.
Label counts are oracle queries, not analyst time.
XAI_full is not best on every metric.

contributions.name: PID temporal fusion
limits: Requires real time-indexed dynamic reports, a frozen dynamic scorer and paired sample identities.
